name: graphql-corpus-production
complexityPolicy: one production parseFile pass per file; the GraphQL analyzer uses a single iterative DFS with Set-backed relationship dedupe — O(nodes + emitted facts), no per-symbol scan
performanceTruth: The analyzer is SLOWER than the one it replaced, and the number is recorded rather than rounded away. Measured on the 20,368-line GitHub public schema, 7 interleaved runs of each cell in SEPARATE processes, medians (fixtures/graphql/probe/perf-attribution.mts, artifact out/perf-attribution.json): parse 342 -> 529 ms (x1.55), analyze 622 -> 1,029 ms (x1.65), total 964 -> 1,558 ms (x1.62), facts 9,264 -> 9,621 (+3.9%). The 2x2 attribution separates the two causes: cell C (old analyzer + new wasm) parses in 613 ms against the old wasm's 657 ms, so the GRAMMAR is not the cost; cell D (new analyzer + old wasm) analyzes in 1,120 ms against 700 ms, so the cost is the code. What the time buys is on the same file: directive applications on every declaration (0 -> 119 on the 47-file corpus), description VALUES with escapes resolved and block strings dedented (the old code returned the raw inner text), a real line on every relationship (M59 #825 — the store's relationship identity is (source, target, type, line)), and every clause of the two left-recursive rules instead of only the last. Two optimisations were taken without dropping any fact: the Directives scan is memoised per node (it ran TWICE on every field before, and was 582 ms of 1,139 ms on this file) and the `extend` lookup is a Set built in the existing pre-pass instead of a re-walk of every top-level definition per scalar. facts/sec moves 14,894 -> 9,350, which is the price, stated.
corpusPolicy: tracked .graphql files from graphql-js@ee5ce41d4b68d1852306d3b56dba2cbbb6c43fea, which is TWO files: the real GitHub public schema (20,367 lines) and the 65-line kitchen-sink torture test. Both now parse with 0 errors — the two grammar limitations this policy used to name are fixed in the vendored grammar. A 2-file sample is not a coverage claim; the 47-file, four-repository sweep is (fixtures/graphql/out/corpus-sweep.json). See also `performanceTruth` and `corpusSize` in graphql-corpus-errors.json.
